description_en: Queries the zones supported by Enterprise Edition transit routers in a specified region
description_zh: 调用ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口查询指定地域下企业版转发路由器支持的可用区信息
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-available-resource --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --support-multicast false --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListTransitRouterAvailableResource

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Enterprise Edition transit router.

You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
企业版转发路由器所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/132080.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query only the multicast-enabled zones.

true: queries only the multicast-enabled zones.

    If the ListTransitRouterAvailableResource operation returns an empty result, the Enterprise Edition transit router in the current region does not support multicast.
false (default): does not query only the multicast-enabled zones
parameters.help_zh:
是否只查询支持组播功能的可用区的信息。

true：是。

    开启查询功能后，如果ListTransitRouterAvailableResource接口返回结果为空，则表示当前地域的企业版转发路由器不支持组播功能。
false（默认值）：否
parameters.name: support_multicast

MasterZones.description_en: The list of primary zone IDs

SlaveZones.description_en: The list of secondary zone IDs

items.description_en:
The list of secondary zone IDs.

You can call [DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html） to query the information about zones that correspond to zone IDs
items.description_zh:
备可用区ID列表。

您可以调用[DescribeZones]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36064.html）接口查询可用区ID对应的可用区的信息

SupportMulticast.description_en: Indicates whether the zone information is for multicast-enabled zones
SupportMulticast.description_zh: 是否为支持组播功能的可用区信息
